user.title: Connect Chaptarr + Audiobookshelf
user.description: Credentials stay in Home Assistant; the books card never sees them.

data_description.abs_token: Shared account: used by every person who does not enter their own key/token. Token of a dedicated, restricted Audiobookshelf user (Settings → Users), not the admin
data_description.komga_url: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:25600 - for the manga card. Leave empty for no manga section.
data_description.komga_api_key: Shared account: used by every person who does not enter their own key/token. Komga -> Account Settings -> API Keys. Use a dedicated Komga user WITHOUT admin rights.
data_description.mylar_url: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8090 - to search and download manga. Leave empty for no download section.
data_description.mylar_api_key: Mylar -> Settings -> Web Interface -> API (enable it there first).
data_description.tolino_url: tolino-bridge address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8199. Leave empty to keep the share-sheet fallback.
data_description.tolino_token: Value of secrets/bridge_token (deploy.sh token on Unraid)
data_description.rescue_imports: Assigns downloads that Chaptarr blocks because of a same-series title mix-up to the book they were grabbed for
data_description.notify_service: Notify entity (e.g. notify.iphone_von_max) or notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone_von_max); separate several with commas. Notified when an automatic repair fails.
data_description.debug_logging: Logs every proxied request at debug level

user.title: Add person
user.description: Every person gets their own accounts, so nobody can change somebody else's reading progress. Empty fields = the shared account from the main settings.

data_description.ha_user: Whoever signs in to Home Assistant with this account.
data_description.komga_api_key: Komga -> Account Settings -> API Keys of this person. Empty = the shared account from the main settings.
data_description.abs_token: Audiobookshelf -> this person's user -> API token. Empty = the shared account from the main settings.
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_annas_phone - this is where "your book is here" goes. Separate several with commas.
data_description.tolino: Shows "send to tolino" and runs auto-send and progress sync with this person's account. Needs a bridge in the main settings.
data_description.notify_test: Sends a test message to the notification target when saving.
data_description.auto_send: New ebooks in Audiobookshelf are sent to this tolino automatically. Only books added AFTER you switch it on. Needs "Uses the Tolino bridge".
data_description.sync_progress: Imports reading position and 'finished' of the books sent to tolino into Audiobookshelf (and the card). Needs "Uses the Tolino bridge".
data_description.sync_progress_write: Sends your state from Audiobookshelf (what you read in the card) to tolino. Needs the option above.
data_description.tolino_account: Name of this person's Thalia account in the bridge (on Unraid: deploy.sh account add NAME). Empty = the bridge's default account. Every person needs their own account.
data_description.import_tolino: Takes the ebooks in this person's tolino account (purchases and free ones, no audiobooks) into Audiobookshelf and tags them for this person. Switching it on imports the whole stock once; later purchases follow by themselves. What is already in Audiobookshelf is skipped. Needs "Uses the Tolino bridge" and the "update" and "upload" permissions for the shared Audiobookshelf user.
data_description.restrict_books: This person only sees the books released for them: books with their tag ("für NAME") or other tags their Audiobookshelf user may see. Needs this person's OWN Audiobookshelf token (field above) of a user whose tag access is limited in Audiobookshelf. Search, requests and downloads are closed for this person.
data_description.import_tolino_audiobooks: Takes the audiobooks (MP3) of this person's tolino account into the Audiobookshelf library named Hörbücher and tags them for this person. A title with three or more readers, or with the word Hörspiel in its description, counts as a radio play and goes with the next switch instead. One audiobook every 10 minutes; while one loads, the Home Assistant config folder needs as much free space as that audiobook. Needs "Uses the Tolino bridge" and the "update" and "upload" permissions for the shared Audiobookshelf user.
data_description.import_tolino_radioplays: Takes the radio plays (Hörspiele) of this person's tolino account into the Audiobookshelf library named Hörspiele and tags them for this person. The shop does not say what is what: three or more readers, or the word Hörspiel in the description, make it a radio play. Same rules as for audiobooks. Needs "Uses the Tolino bridge".

user.title: Manage Thalia accounts
user.description: The tolino bridge's Thalia accounts, one per person. Nothing is stored in Home Assistant here; the credentials live in the bridge only.

create.title: Create a new Thalia account
create.description: The person must have signed in once at webreader.mytolino.com. The password is sent **once** in clear text (HTTP on your home network) to the bridge and is not stored here; the bridge logs in right away (up to a minute). If the login fails the account is removed again. {detail}

data_description.name: a-z, 0-9, _ and - (up to 32 characters, no capitals), e.g. the first name. You then enter this name at the person as their Tolino account.
data_description.thalia_user: The e-mail address of this person's Thalia account.
data_description.thalia_password: The password of the Thalia account.

rename.title: Rename the "default" account
rename.description: Gives the original account the name of its person. The login is kept (no new login). Affected person: {person}. They are switched to the new name and keep their list of sent books. {detail}

data_description.to: a-z, 0-9, _ and - (up to 32 characters, no capitals), e.g. the first name.

remove.title: Remove an account
remove.description: Deletes the account's credentials, session and Chrome profile in the bridge and the matching list of sent books here. The Thalia account itself is untouched. An account that a person still uses cannot be removed. {detail}

error.name_invalid: Name: a-z, 0-9, _ and - (up to 32 characters, no capitals, not "default")
error.name_taken: The bridge already has an account with this name
error.credentials_missing: Please enter the e-mail and the password
error.login_captcha: Thalia asks for a captcha (bot protection). Try again later.
error.login_rejected: Thalia rejected the credentials (wrong e-mail or password, or two-factor is on)
error.login_no_device: This account has no device yet: sign in once at webreader.mytolino.com
error.login_backoff: The bridge is still waiting after a failed login. Try again later.
error.login_failed: The login failed (details in the bridge log: ./deploy.sh logs)
error.account_in_use: A person still uses this account: change or remove the person first

abort.no_bridge: No tolino bridge is set in the main settings
abort.nothing_to_remove: There is no account that can be removed ("default" can only be renamed)
abort.account_created: The account "{name}" is created and logged in. Now enter "{name}" at the person as their Tolino account.
abort.account_renamed: The account is now called "{name}" (login kept, {books} sent books carried over).

move_tolino_account.name: Rename a Tolino account
move_tolino_account.description: Carries the list of sent books and the auto-send state of a Tolino account over to a new name. Run it once after 'deploy.sh account rename-default NAME' on Unraid; the new name must already be entered at the person as their Tolino account.

to_account.name: New account name
to_account.description: The name in the bridge, e.g. anna.

no_person.title: No person added yet
no_person.description: Without a person nobody can use the cards: everybody needs their own accounts (reading progress, notifications, tolino). Open Settings > Devices & services > Books and tap "Add person", ideally for every Home Assistant user who uses the cards.

upstream_auth.title: {service} refuses access
upstream_auth.description: {service} refused the key/token for "{person}" (401). The cards then show errors instead of content. Check the key under Settings > Devices & services > Books (at the person, or in the main settings if it says "-"), e.g. after it was renewed. This hint disappears as soon as it works again.
